_help: Settings for the real-data build (python data/build_real.py). Paths are relative to data/. Set a path to null to skip that source; its fake file then stays in data/out/.
name: Jezero crater, delta front (eastern lobe)
_center_note: Chosen by eye on the USGS HiRISE DTM mosaic (13 Nov): the 2 km square covers the eastern lobe of the delta front and the crater floor below it, about 3 km west of the Octavia E. Butler landing site (18.4447 N, 77.4508 E). Not a published coordinate. Longitude is degrees east, 0 to 360.

hirise._example_note: The example names are from the USGS Mars 2020 TRN mosaics; use the real names of the files you downloaded.
hirise.label: HiRISE (MRO), USGS Mars 2020 TRN mosaic of Jezero

themis._tile_note: Tile 00N060E covers 0-30 N, 60-120 E, which includes Jezero (checked 13 Nov). Absolute accuracy of THEMIS thermal inertia is about 20% (USGS).
themis._kind_help: thermal_inertia = quantitative TI in SI units (best); night_ir = night-time brightness only (qualitative, still shows sand vs rock)
themis.label: THEMIS (Mars Odyssey), thermal inertia mosaic

crism._threshold_note: Each threshold is the 95th percentile of that parameter over the whole CRISM image FRT00005C5E (so the strongest 5% of the image is coloured). A relative cut-off chosen by us, not a published detection limit. Parameters follow Viviano-Beck et al. 2014: OLINDEX3 olivine, D2300 Fe/Mg clays, MIN2295_2480 carbonates.
crism.label: CRISM (MRO), MTRDR summary parameters, image FRT00005C5E

meda._sols_note: Placeholder: sols early in the delta front campaign (it began on sol 415). Set them to the sols you downloaded.
meda._columns_note: Column names are guesses until checked: run python data/tables.py <file> and copy the real names. Add "sol": "<column>" only if the sol is not in the file name.
meda._dust_note: Not measured by MEDA in these files. A single estimate; replace it with a Mastcam-Z or SkyCam tau value if you find one.
meda.label: MEDA (Perseverance)

rems._note: Curiosity (Gale) weather. Not used for Jezero: use the meda block. Leave file null.
rems._dust_note: REMS does not measure dust opacity (tau). This single value is an estimate for the season; replace it with a Mastcam tau value if you find one.
rems.label: REMS (Curiosity)

rad._note: Perseverance has no dose instrument, so Jezero uses the estimate below (file stays null). The constant is written for every hour of sols; keep sols equal to meda.sols.

estimate.source: Curiosity RAD surface average at Gale, 0.64 mSv/day (Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343). Applied unchanged at Jezero, which sits about 2 km higher than Gale crater's floor under a thinner atmosphere, so the real dose is probably somewhat higher.

rad._qf_note: Converts absorbed dose (Gy) to dose equivalent (Sv). 3.05 = 0.64 mSv/day / 0.21 mGy/day, the surface averages Hassler et al. (2014, Science) reported from RAD. An approximation.
rad.label: RAD (Curiosity)
